title: Impact of Political Turnover on Public Spending
research_question: How does a close-election Democratic win influence public spending? By using close-election victories as an instrument, we aim to isolate the causal effect of Democratic control on the level of public spending.
data_description: The dataset contains 400 observations with columns: y (log public spending), x (Democratic control), z (close-election Democratic win), and controls (various socio-economic indicators). The instrument, z, is used to account for potential endogeneity in x.
